title: Hill climb and push · Level 3: Push the box
brief: On the flat floor, push the 600 g box (a 150 mm cube, 305 mm ahead of the robot) 900 mm so it ends wholly in the green zone; the run ends when your program ends (and the robot stands still), or at 90 s; the box is judged then (a program that stops on an error gets no zone). Five starts (±10 mm, ±2°). 50 for the box wholly in the zone, plus 40 × min(1, par ÷ time) with it, plus 10 if the wheels' count - counted at the robot's real wheel - ends no more than 90 mm past the distance the robot truly went along its path. Pass: mean 60 or more and the box in the zone in at least 4 of 5 runs.

score.run: if(wholly_box_zone & (stopped | time >= limitS), 50 + 40 * min(1, par / time), 0) + if(overCountMm <= 90, 10, 0)
